reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Laura Altobelli
reviews.text: Our nextdoor neighbor recommended Rich and his crew, so we texted him after we moved into a new neighborhood filled with beautifully manicured lawns. While we were unpacking and getting settled, we knew we wouldn't be up to the task of maintaining our new lawn up to the neighborhood standards right away. Rich was amenable to coming out with no obligation to sign a long-term contract, and he did a beautiful job at a fantastic price. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend him to anyone in the Mount Laurel area.

reviews.author: Mario Duckett
reviews.text: Diamond Lawncare is absolutely the best! Flexible, accommodating, reasonably priced and the work is top notch. I would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Teresa Terzano
reviews.text: I highly recommend Diamond Lawncare, they came out right away when I had a very large, heavy tree branch that fell during the storm onto my shrubs, and were able to remove it safely without damaging anything in the landscaping bed. Very fair price, professional, and prompt!

reviews.author: Laurie Zemble
reviews.text: Diamond Lawncare did a wonderful job on our spring cleanup! They are professional, kind, prompt, and take pride in their work. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nicole Marincola
reviews.text: Diamond Lawn Care is hands down the best landscaping company around. The owner is incredibly caring, responsible, responsive, and reliable. He is hands-on with every single job and truly takes pride in his work. From the moment you hire him, you know you’re in good hands and don’t have to worry all season, that peace of mind is worth every penny. His prices are fair and more than reasonable, which makes the experience even better. It’s clear why he has such a loyal clientele. You won’t regret calling Diamond Lawn Care for any of your landscaping needs.

reviews.author: Ethan Adamiak
reviews.text: Stand out customer service! Communication was easy and convenient. It was a pleasure to work with them and will definitely be using again.

reviews.author: Alexis Gopal
reviews.text: Rich is a very professional young man with a very strong work ethic. He and his fabulous team treat my lawn as if were their own. Family, friends and colleagues rave over my landscaping. If I ever have questions, or special requests, Rich treats me as if I were a family member. His prices are reasonable, and his company takes me back to the days when people took pride in their work. I feel very lucky to have found Diamond Lawncare. I wish all businesses were run this way.

reviews.author: Rich
reviews.text: I have used Diamond landscaping for grass cutting. They just did mulch at my home. They did a wonderful job just like I would have. the attention to detail was great. Nick who put the mulch down should be proud of himself. This company is a pleasure to work with. don't hesitate to use this company for your landscaping needs

reviews.author: Cameron Sotelo
reviews.text: Very satisfied with there service, very reliable, respectful, hardworking crew! Will use them again every time I am in need

reviews.author: Harrison Ogilvie
reviews.text: Diamond lawn care's services have been exceptional. They're very quick and there's never any scheduling issues. I have my lawn mowed and edged weekly and I couldn't be happier with both the price and service. Much better than my past experience with a previous landscaper.

reviews.author: Jodi C
reviews.text: I called Diamond Lawncare 2 days before a snow storm to secure snow removal. They were extremely quick, responsive and well-priced. I was notified about a price change due to an increase in snow totals in a timely manner. They arrived to plow our driveway at the agreed-upon time and did a great job removing the snow so that driveway was usable. I would definitely recommend their snow removal service.

reviews.author: Justin Goldman
reviews.text: We have had nothing but great experiences with Rich and the Diamond Lawncare team. They are reliable, professional and do a great job with our landscaping. I’ve had Rich do many other things outside of our normal lawn mowing, including removing an old garden box and trimming our trees, and he has done an excellent job at all. His prices are very reasonable and I know I can count on him to make our lawn and surrounding outside area look great!

reviews.author: Walter Widzins
reviews.text: I was highly impressed with how fast rich (owner) got in contact with me after leaving a message for services ! him & his team are very thorough with everything they do & take pride in their work !! I definitely was not disappointed in choosing Diamond Lawncare! I will use them for any needs in the future for sure !!

reviews.author: Sean Tietz
reviews.text: Rich and his team were great. They did a phenomenal job cleaning up our yard and making it look nice. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Maria Fernanda Munguia
reviews.text: I needed a company to clean out my townhome backyard as quickly as possible. I normally do my own yard clean up but this fall that was not an option. Diamond Lawncare came highly recommended from Mount Laurel and Surrounding Towns FB page so I decided to reach out. The owner was extremely responsive which is really important to me because if you take to long to respond I will get distracted and move on. Communication was great and they had no issues getting into my backyard through the easement in the back which is amazing because otherwise they would have needed to it through the middle of my house which is not ideal as we take off our shoes in the house bc our little has really bad allergies. The crew was quick and my husband and I are very pleased because in no time they did what would have taken us an entire day of sweat and backaches to do. Don’t wait, give them a try!

reviews.author: Andrew Mickel
reviews.text: Been using Diamond Lawncare and their services for years now. Always prompt and meet my needs and expectations. They work fast, hard and are flexible with pricing. Can always count on them. The owner is also very nice

reviews.author: John O'Sullivan
reviews.text: I've been with Diamond Landscaping since the beginning. They do a great job maintaining my lawn--very dependable and always on schedule. Richie does an excellent job communicating, especially when weather issues arise and scheduling changes are needed. I highly recommend for all your landscaping needs.

reviews.author: Stephen Bodnar
reviews.text: I have used Diamond Lawn and Landscape for years for lawn landscaping, yard clean up, aeration, and more. Rich Vitulle and his team do quality work and are very reliable. While Diamond has grown over the years, Rich continues to provide the great customer service we have experienced from Day One.

reviews.author: E Nice
reviews.text: I've been using Diamond Lawncare for 5 years and my lawn has never looked better. The service provided has been excellent and at a fair price. Rich is a very responsive owner and is easy to do business with.

reviews.author: Aaron Smith
reviews.text: Rich and his crew did an amazing job on my property. We had them cut the grass, add new mulch to the mulch bed, get he weeds out, and dug out a small tree. They were on time, quick and responsive when we talked back and forth. We will be using them in September for another project we want done.

reviews.author: Dawn Mickel
reviews.text: Diamond Lawn Care took my dried out patchy grass and made it look lush, vibrant green with a uniform carpet-like appearance. I will never use anyone else. Rich and his team are considerate, friendly and extremely talented. Thank you Diamond Lawn care!!!

reviews.author: Deanna Howard
reviews.text: Richie and his crew did a phenomenal job on my lawn. I have 3 acres, and no grass was left in my mulch beds, on the fence, or in the pool/hott tub. They are always careful around my marble statues, and even greet my frenchies and mini pom when they arrive. I will use them as long as my husband allows, I love them! 24 carat lawn every time ;)

reviews.author: Jake Giblin
reviews.text: They service around where I live and are very considerate to the neighbors, kind to me when I asked them to move so I could park my truck. Quick well done cuts that look pristine. Quality service for a decent price.

reviews.author: Nicole Reese
reviews.text: Diamond Lawncare was an exceptional service and was happy that we used them! They were quick to respond and were out to do a spring cleanup and a garden upgrade. We had a great experience and our landscaping looks better than ever!

reviews.author: Tiffany Watkins
reviews.text: I just want to say I am extremely satisfied on the work that was done to my yard from the trimming to the mowing everything looks fantastic. Pricing was very reasonable for all the work they did . I will definitely be referring you to my family and friends.

reviews.author: Gina March
reviews.text: Diamond has been taking care of our lawn for years. Rich is great! He's professional, prompt and knows his business. I highly recommend his service, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Jason Geneblazo
reviews.text: Rich and his crew at Diamond Lawn Care are professional and top notch ! Communication is outstanding and they always provide me with A++ Service and affordable pricing ! Every year I go to rich for my lawn servicing needs and he never disappoints .

reviews.author: Brian B
reviews.text: We have been with Diamond Lawn Care for 2 years now. I can tell you based on the service and professionalism provided we plan on being with Rich and his team for many more years to come. If your looking for a lawn care service trust me there is no need to look any further. Thank you Diamond!!

reviews.author: Tara Delozier
reviews.text: Rich and his crew are great! In addition to basic lawn care, he’s been able to help us with weeding and preparing a flower bed. Super responsive and always up to a challenge. Would most definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Sabrina Tis
reviews.text: Diamond Lawncare is a wonderfully run company! The owner and his crew are so friendly, and can deliver A+ quality every time. They’re time efficient, and their work proves they care. Won’t go anywhere else as long as they’re in business!

reviews.author: Brittany Pierdolla
reviews.text: Consistently great work and exceptional customer service. I appreciate that the owner isn't afraid to get his hands dirty and go the extra mile to make sure the customer is satisfied. Great teamwork! Always very responsive and helpful.

reviews.author: karen jablonsky
reviews.text: I’ve been a client of Diamond lawn care for ten years. Always professional, always timely, always job well done! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Yemisi okunnuga
reviews.text: I was so amazed this morning, while I was mowing my lawn, this company were busy with my neighbors lawn but just came over and took over mowing, trimming and blowing my lawn. I was too excited. I did not pay them but they just did it for me. I am very grateful for such considerate work. I will choose them over and over again.

reviews.author: Lisa and Michael DiChristofer
reviews.text: We are new customers to Diamond Lawncare, LLC and could not be happier. The lawn service has been great and our lawn has never looked better. Diamond Lawncare is a full-service provider and we also had them do tree removal. Great value for the money. M. DiChristofer

reviews.author: Scott Killick
reviews.text: We used Diamond Lawncare for a few years and they always do a great job keeping our lawn in shape. They are efficient, affordable, and professional. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Jake Nolan
reviews.text: Anyone looking for landscaping help, you won't find anyone easier to work with than Richie. They say diamonds are forever so the company is aptly named. Once you use his services you'll be sticking with him forever.

reviews.author: Tom G
reviews.text: I highly recommend the services of Diamond Lawncare, and owner Rich Vitulle. Diamond Lawncare handled all lawn care needs on my property in Maple Shade, NJ and the service was excellent! No issues and a high level of service during past 4 years. If you desire high level lawn care service, reach out to Diamond Lawncare.

reviews.author: Jeff Kelly
reviews.text: I found Diamond to be very reasonable priced. They listened to my concerns and followed through on schedule. When they were finished they walked me through for approval. I look forward to coming home each week and enjoying my well kept lawn.

reviews.author: Terron Morman
reviews.text: Rich and his crew were polite, professional and their attention to detail made it clear to me that Diamond Lawncare will be servicing my home for the foreseeable future.

reviews.author: T Ferg
reviews.text: So easy to work with and affordable. I had them remove trees, weeds, and poison ivy from my backyard and get the house all cleaned up for the spring. They were super professional and did a great job.

reviews.author: Joann DiPeri
reviews.text: Diamond Lawncare has been doing my lawn for several year. Richard is a fine young man, polite, courteous, and hardworking. I would not hesitate to recommend Diamond Lawncare to others.

reviews.author: Gene B
reviews.text: Rich and team did an excellent job. Made our yard beautiful again. Great crew amd cleanup too! Thanks Diamond Lawncare!

reviews.author: Joseph DiGiacomo
reviews.text: Diamond Lawn has been great. I just started using them this year. Rich responds quickly to texts. Lawn looks fabulous!

reviews.author: Evan Wright
reviews.text: Rich and his crew have been doing my landscape for years. Very responsive and they do a great job every time. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Marilyn K
reviews.text: Rich and his crew always do an amazing job on my spring cleanup. Their attention to detail shows and I always highly recommend them. The best!

reviews.author: Candis Hansen
reviews.text: They service where I live and are constantly blocking driveways to service their clients, are rude if you ask them to move, and don't pay attention to when crossing the crosswalk. I was in the crosswalk with my 3 year old child and they ran through it while we were walking. I wouldn't give them business with how ignorant they are.

reviews.author: Dave Zatorski
reviews.text: Rich worked with me on pricing different projects. His team did exactly as planned. Very happy with the end result.

reviews.author: Joe Florek
reviews.text: I’ve had Rich work on my lawn since 2017. He’s very dependable and affordable and does a great job! I would highly recommend him!

reviews.author: Cash Woldseth
reviews.text: Handled with care and respect. The team and the owner listened to my desired and executed perfectly. Look forward to remaining the Diamond Lawncare for the future.

reviews.author: Sean Remington
reviews.text: My front and back yard was overgrown with weeds growing all around the house. Diamond Lawncare took care took care of everything and now my house is presentable again.

reviews.author: Leslie Williams
reviews.text: I was extremely pleased with the high quality and professional service received. I would definitely recommend their services to others and will be using them again myself

reviews.author: Donald W Garecht
reviews.text: Rich and his crew do a nice job in cutting our lawn. He completed our spring cleanup and did an awesome job!!

reviews.author: Dean Kleinschrodt
reviews.text: Contracted them for a few jobs and they exceeded expectations every time. On time, professional, detail oriented, and reasonably priced. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Maria Hurdle
reviews.text: Can’t wait to have the guys come back and clean up my backyard for a second time next week. Excellent service and quick and efficient!!

reviews.author: Sheldon Bryant
reviews.text: I’ve used Rich and Diamond Lawncare for 7 years and I couldn’t be happier. He was very responsive and went out of his way to help!

reviews.author: DiDi
reviews.text: Great personal lawn service! I have been using this lawn service and snow removal for many years. Great business! I highly recommend

reviews.author: Nick Silvidio
reviews.text: Rich is the best there is. Reasonable pricing and does a fantastic job. Highly recommend. Thanks again!!

reviews.author: zachary howes
reviews.text: I started having them do my lawn last year and they are awesome. They will be cutting my lawn next season

reviews.author: Eddie Beck
reviews.text: Unreal, it was hard to find someone to do my lawn exactly how I wanted, Rich and his team really knocked it out the park.
